scenes.say: What is OEE, and why do so many plants track it?
scenes.html:
Explainer
What is OEE?
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: OEE stands for Overall Equipment Effectiveness. It shows how much of your planned production time is truly productive.
scenes.html:
Overall Equipment Effectiveness
How much planned time
is truly productive
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: It multiplies three numbers: availability, times performance, times quality.
scenes.html:
The formula
OEE = A × P × Q
Availability × Performance × Quality
OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality (standard definition)
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Availability is run time divided by planned production time. Breakdowns, changeovers and waiting pull it down.
scenes.html:
Availability
Run time ÷
planned time
Breakdowns, changeovers and waiting pull it down
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Performance compares how fast you actually ran to the ideal speed. Slow cycles and small stops pull it down.
scenes.html:
Performance
Actual speed ÷
ideal speed
Slow cycles and small stops pull it down
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Quality is good parts divided by total parts. Scrap and rework pull it down.
scenes.html:
Quality
Good parts ÷
total parts
Scrap and rework pull it down
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Each of the three hides a different kind of loss, so OEE tells you not only how much you're losing, but where.
scenes.html:
Why three numbers
Not just how much.
Where.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Example. A line is available ninety percent of the time, runs at ninety-five percent of ideal speed, and ninety-eight percent of its parts are good.
scenes.html:
Example
Availability
90%
Performance
95%
Quality
98%
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Ninety percent, times ninety-five percent, times ninety-eight percent, is about eighty-three point eight percent OEE.
scenes.html:
Multiply them
0.90 × 0.95 × 0.98
83.8%
OEE
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Three numbers that each look fine still add up to losing about one sixth of your planned time.
scenes.html:
The surprise
Each looks fine.
Together: about 1/6 lost.
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: The real value is in the why. Tag every stop with a reason, and a Pareto chart shows which few causes cost you the most.
scenes.html:
Find the why
Tag every stop.
Pareto the reasons.
A few causes usually cost the most
Syon Automation LLC

scenes.say: Measure it the same way every shift, straight from the PLC, not from memory, or the numbers won't be comparable.
scenes.html:

not from memory
